claims.statement: For the exact two-bit Boolean AND half-tax margin D=M_A+Delta_A/2-J_A, D(p,q)>0 for every 0<p<=1/64 and every 0<=q<=1.
claims.coverage: Complete continuum rare-bias tail including q=0, q=1 and every simultaneous q approach; no dimension or parameter sample inference.
claims.proof_interface: Exact singular extraction D*ln(2)/p=A ln(1/p)+F, analytic A>=0, and directed interval proof of A ln(64)+F>0 on the compactified closed rectangle.
claims.gu_implication: Conditional on higher-arity half-tax, cancellation/telescoping of all M_A terms, and nonreuse sum Delta_A<=I, one obtains G<=I/2 and hence H<=3I.
